en.t: I knew that his name was Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 柏木最明显的特征就是那双严重的X型的腿，走路实在艰难。

en.t: Kashiwagi's most obvious feature was his severely knock-kneed legs, which made walking truly difficult.

units.source_text: 总是像在泥泞中行走，一只脚好不容易从泥泞中拨出，另一只脚又深深地陷了进去。

en.t: It was always as if he were walking through mud: no sooner had he managed to pull one foot free than the other sank deeply in again.

units.source_text: 每迈一步，全身跃动，他的行走就是一种夸张的舞蹈，完全失去了常态。

en.t: With every step his whole body bounced, and his way of walking was an exaggerated dance, utterly removed from anything normal.
